title: Slaytra
extract:
Slaytra is Kahl-175's signature melee weapon as he hunts down  Narmer forces in Veilbreaker and his subsequent Break Narmer weekly quests. Unlike the standard  Grineer  Machete, the Slaytra's  Slash procs last twice as long as normal.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Innate +100%  Slash proc duration.
Bonus is additive other status duration buffs, such as  Lasting Sting.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Sundering Weave,  Cyclone Kraken and  Rending Wind (Conclave only) stance.

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high total damage (333)
High damage × attack speed (329.81)
Above average block angle (55°)
High follow through (0.7x)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)

Acquisition
Slaytra's blueprint is available from Chipper of Kahl's Garrison for 30  Stock, requiring players to be at Rank 2 - Encampment to purchase.

Trivia
The Slaytra is simply named "Machete" in Break Narmer missions, rather than its own name.
